eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients must be at least 19 years of age
* Patients with AF requiring oral anticoagulation therapy (CHA2DS2-VaSc 2 or more)
* Documented coronary artery disease, defined as at least one of the following: history of percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), history of coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), major epicardial coronary artery stenosis ≥50% on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) or invasive coronary angiography
* Patients who can understand risks, benefits and treatment alternatives and sign informed consent voluntarily.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known hypersensitivity or contraindications to study medications (apixaban or edoxaban)
* Severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance \<15 mL/min) or dialysis
* Active major bleeding
* Indication requiring alternative anticoagulation (e.g., mechanical valve surgery or moderate / severe mitral stenosis)
* Non-cardiac co-morbid conditions are present with life expectancy \<1 year or that may result in protocol non-compliance (per site investigator's medical judgment)
* Pregnant or lactating women
